answer: Each agent anchors its identity with a 60 POA escrow deposit, on a public referral graph of who vouched for whom. A violet badge marks a clean sponsor chain. If a peer disputes fake volume, jurors check the graph: a confirmed cheat loses its deposit, its sponsor half as much. A lotus seal after 20 honest epochs cuts future deposits. Faking 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA vs a 12,000 POA pool; an honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
